description: Macroeconomic conditions (ISM PMI business cycle index). PMI > 50 = expansion, PMI < 50 = contraction. The first reading is the Day 1 startup snapshot, not a full-period average. Later readings average each full measurement period (default: Days 2-31, 32-61, etc.). All readings use the configured publication delay (default: 30 days), so the first appears on Day 31, then Day 61, 91, etc. Published data reflects past conditions, not real-time PMI.

columns.day: INTEGER PRIMARY KEY — Measurement-period end day (not publication day). Day 1 denotes the startup snapshot; later rows end full measurement periods. The row appears after the configured publication delay (default: 30 days).
columns.pmi_value: REAL — ISM PMI (30-70 scale): Day 1 startup snapshot for the first reading, full measurement-period average thereafter. >50 = expansion, <50 = contraction.
columns.pmi_change: REAL — Change from the previous reading (positive = improving); the startup reading is compared with the configured initial PMI.
columns.cycle_phase: TEXT — 'peak', 'declining', 'trough', 'recovering' — current position in business cycle
columns.description: TEXT — Human-readable economic summary for the measurement period
